dict.Ce trebuie comandat și cât: din stocul l: What to order and how much: from the current stock, what is already on the way, the average monthly usage, the delivery time and the safety days you get how many days the stock still lasts, the reorder point and the quantity to order, with its value; the status: sufficient (green), to order (yellow) or out of stock (red).
dict.Cantitatea de comandat ajunge până la pu: The quantity to order brings the stock up to the reorder point plus one more month of usage; prices can be compared in Sheets → Offer comparison.
dict.Punctul de comandă = consumul pe zilele: Reorder point = usage over the delivery days plus the safety days; when the stock plus what is on the way reaches it, you order.
dict.Stocul la zi se ia din fișa de magazie (: The current stock comes from the stock card (Sheets → Stock card); the average usage, from the issues of the last months.
